BiblicalUsage: lîylîyth means a night spectre, and once is enough to see what it is doing. In Isaiah 34:14, "the screech owl also shall rest there".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the night spectre haunts only the ruins — Isaiah sets it in Edom's desolation, where the wild beasts meet and the screech owl rests.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
